author: ravenatorman
body:
I would like to be unbanned so that I can play on your server again. I am sorry for hacking and I promise to never use an unfair advantage again. I want to be unbanned so that I can play on this server with my friends again, and the reason I started hacking was because I didn't think I would ever play on this server again, but then my friends made a clan on this server and I would like to join.

title: ravenatorman's appeal

replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
Hello,

I'm going to have to deny this appeal because hacking usually constitutes for a ban length of 4-8 months depending on the situation, so I suggest you appeal in a few more months.

-John
